title: Corelib harness performance (engine reuse, sub-5min matrix)
body:
The current production gate is one `beskid test --all-targets --plain` invocation over 61 manifest entries; the historical `compiler/corelib/ci/run_corelib_tests.py` path no longer exists. Fresh evidence found no compiler deadlock: inherited PTY stdin stopped `SystemInputReadTests` with SIGTTIN, while `</dev/null` produced deterministic EOF and completed every sampled target. The first EOF-bound five-minute run completed 49 targets (18 pass / 31 fail); the remaining 12 completed separately, yielding a full 20/61 functional baseline. Repeated materialization and typechecking consumed 245s system time and remain the performance bottleneck.

## Acceptance

- Fresh functional matrix is 61/61
- One EOF-bound `--all-targets` run completes under **5 minutes**
- Simple assertion targets complete under **200ms**

## Blocked on

Functional `corelib-matrix-green` exit (61/61).

**Linear:** [CYB-181](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-181/v04-recover-authoritative-61-target-corelib-matrix-and-bounded-harness)
